chapter: Cavalcade, Wynonie Harris and the 1953 show
title: Cavalcade of Jazz with Jack Teagarden
summary: On a 1947 touring package with Teagarden, Dinah Washington, Lips Page and others, Durham wrote the whole show.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, what was this thing then -- it says, '47, toured with the Cavalcade of Jazz. That was Irving Muller's thing, wasn't it?
I have a book on that. That was Jimmy Evans. Jack Teagarden was the star.
And Jack Teagarden -- the trombone section was Jack Teagarden, Jesse Hickenbocker and myself.
The singer was Dinah Washington, June Christie, Charley Van Tour, Lee Castle, Red Rodney, Lips Page and Flat Top Wilson. And we had a piano player, African fellow named Freddy Weiss (inaudible).
And that was -- we did about 15 states. We even went to Canada and did the (inaudible). I got the book on it, a whole book, everybody's in it.
Was that the thing that Irving Mills did?
